data.title: Data
data.voice: When you speak to practise (“Speak”, “Out loud”), speech recognition is done by your phone’s own service (Apple or Google), not by Daily Lingua. We only receive the recognised text, never a recording of your voice. That text is handled like written text: it is sent for correction and stays in your journal.
